17-13-0303-C (1) Narrative & Plans Zoning Analysis - 2651 West Augusta
Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment to a RM-4.5 Residential MuUi-lJnit District.

A. Proposed Land Use: To erect a new three (3) story residential building with a roof deck and roof top
stair, stop stair enclosure, and three (3) residential units and a new three (3) car garage on a currently
vacant lot at 2651 W. Augusta Boulevard.

Lot Area: 3,116.25 sq. f.

B. Proposed Floor Area Ratio: 1.48

C. Density (Lot Area Per Dwelling Unit): 1038.67 sq. f

D. Off-street parking: The property is proposed to have a three (3) car garage.

E. Setbacks (proposed)

a. Front Setback: 8.0'

b. Rear Setbacks: 39'-3'/4"

c. Side Setbacks

        West: 3.0'

        East: 2.0'

d. Rear Yard Open Space: 215.0 sq. f with minimum 10 feet

e. Building Height: 40'-6"

Attached plans provided
